items.name: Occupancy Certificate (OC)
items.notes: Must cover all blocks and phases completely. Essential for legal residency and water connections.

items.name: Completion Certificate (CC)
items.notes: Issued by the local planning authority, confirming that execution matches the approved maps.

items.name: Parent Title Deeds
items.notes: Mother Deed, Land Sale Agreements, and Title Clearance or Encumbrance Certificates for 30 years.

items.name: Approved Layout Plans
items.notes: Sanctioned building blueprints and floor plans approved by the municipal corporation or town planning board.

items.name: Joint Development Agreement
items.notes: If built through a JDA, collect the allocation sheet and registered agreement between the landowner and builder.

items.name: Declaration & Bye-laws
items.notes: Deed of Declaration submitted under the local Apartment Ownership Act.

items.name: As-Built Structure Drawings
items.notes: Detailed architectural, structural, foundation, and column placement maps.

items.name: Electrical Systems & Schematics
items.notes: Single Line Diagrams, transformer specifications, generator wiring, panel room distributions, and lightning protection maps.

items.name: Plumbing & Drainage Layouts
items.notes: Inflow and outflow pipelines, water tank configurations, borewell pits, and municipal water line entry blueprints.

items.name: STP & WTP Layouts
items.notes: Operations manuals, pipeline schematics, and chemical storage plans for the Sewage and Water Treatment Plants.

items.name: Firefighting & Piping Networks
items.notes: Sprinkler layouts, fire hydrant locations, smoke detector wiring maps, and escape routes.

items.name: Fire Department NOC
items.notes: Valid No Objection Certificate from Fire & Emergency Services. It must be active and requires annual renewal.

items.name: Lift Operational Licenses
items.notes: Valid registration and safety clearance certificates from the Inspector of Lifts.

items.name: Consent to Operate (CTO)
items.notes: Environmental clearance from the State Pollution Control Board for DG sets and STP operations.

items.name: Active AMCs & Warranties
items.notes: Original Annual Maintenance Contracts and warranty documents for lifts, generators, pumps, CCTVs, and transformers.

items.name: Vendor Service Ledgers
items.notes: Contact information and outstanding ledger balances for existing security, housekeeping, and technical staff.

items.name: IFMS Corpus Fund Transfer
items.notes: Complete transfer of Interest-Free Maintenance Security, along with up-to-date bank account statements and interest logs.

items.name: Audited Society Accounts
items.notes: Certified financial balances showing all maintenance revenue collections and expenses under the builder's tenure.

items.name: Property Tax Receipts
items.notes: Proof of paid property and land taxes up to the exact formal date of society management handover.

items.name: Utility Bill Ledgers
items.notes: Zero-due certificates and payment confirmations for shared electrical connections, water tankers, and common-area grids.

items.name: Indemnity Bond
items.notes: A registered legal undertaking protecting the association from past tax claims, pending litigation, or pre-handover construction liabilities.

items.name: RERA Defect Liability Clause
items.notes: A formal written document reiterating the developer's five-year structural defect liability window as mandated by RERA.
